playstyle.identity: Aurora is a bunny-hopping burst mage who dashes between spirit realm and reality. She excels at repositioning and bursting with her spirit-powered abilities.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive heals and damages when exiting targets. Q curses then procs for damage. W dashes and enters spirit realm (heals). E is a skillshot that can hit spirits. R traps enemies in a zone they can't escape. Hop in and out to proc passive.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Aurora spikes at level 6 with her trapping ultimate. AP items scale her burst. She's strong at picks and teamfight zone control.

weaknesses: R can be escaped with dashes

passive.name: Spirit Abjuration
passive.summary: Exiting enemies heals you and deals damage; entering marks them.
passive.details: When Aurora enters an enemy, she marks them. Exiting marked enemies deals magic damage and heals her. Rewards weaving in and out of fights.

abilities.name: Twofold Hex
abilities.summary: Fire a missile that curses, then fire again to detonate for damage.
abilities.details: Aurora fires a missile that damages and curses enemies. Recast sends another missile that deals additional damage to cursed targets.

abilities.name: Across the Veil
abilities.summary: Hop and enter spirit realm briefly, becoming untargetable and healing.
abilities.details: Aurora hops in a direction and briefly enters the spirit realm, becoming untargetable, healing, and gaining movement speed. She can hop again while in spirit realm.

abilities.name: The Weirding
abilities.summary: Skillshot that damages and slows, also hitting spirits.
abilities.details: Aurora sends out a spirit missile that damages and slows enemies. Can hit enemies in the spirit realm as well.

abilities.name: Between Worlds
abilities.summary: Create a zone that traps enemies inside, preventing escape.
abilities.details: Aurora creates a large zone. Enemies inside can't leave the zone (dashes and movement are blocked at the edge). She can freely enter and exit.
